# The API generated code may call (TestContract, docs/design/library.md).
#
# public: documented API a person writes by hand. Generated code calls
# nothing else: what it would need and a person couldn't call is a gap in
# the public API, filled there (library.md, "No hidden runtime").
# generated: what generated code alone calls — ui's uigen, the lowering of a
# .vuka.html file's client state and tracked server state; ui.LiveSchema,
# the lowering of a live page's hook and field attributes (@ui.Mount,
# @ui.OnChange, @ui.Loads, @ui.Bind, @ui.URL, @ui.Defer); ui.HTML, the
# lowering of a .vuka.html file's markup, and ui.IslandPage, an island
# page's. Public so the generated code builds with go build, ejected code
# included; not an API a person writes (vukavet reports a hand-written
# use: W0105, W0306, W0106), so it is the compiler's to change. web.Routes
# stays public: a route decorator on a function lowers to it, and a page
# registered on it by hand is E0720; pages/route.go's own options
# (web.PageRoute, LayoutOf, GuardOf, UseOf, Receiver) are W0702 by hand.
# ui.State's own API is Get and Set.
# stepN: an internal form generated code still calls, until step N of the
# Plan gives it a public replacement; none is left. An entry no golden uses
# fails the test.

# Kept from step 3, made public: what has no schema method to go in.
# RegisterFields is the field attributes of a struct embedding neither
# orm.Base nor ui.Live (read back with FieldAttrsOf). StaticOf, Static and
# Statics are a static of a generic type, one value per instantiation,
# which a package-level variable can't be.
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.RegisterFields
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.Static
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.StaticOf
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.Statics

# A field reference on a struct with no generated typed fields
# (Stats.Author of a plain struct) is the field by address, a kind of
# reference per field type. Call decorators are vuka.Wrap, reflective; the
# package's vuka_calls_gen.go registers a typed adapter per signature, a
# speed-up the main file doesn't depend on.
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.CompareRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.NullableRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.OrderedRefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.RefTo
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka/v2.StringRefTo
